name: ons-if
description:
[en]
  Conditionally display content depending on the platform, device orientation or both.
  Sometimes it is useful to conditionally hide or show certain components based on platform. When running on iOS the `<ons-if>` element can be used to hide the `<ons-fab>` element.
[/en]
[ja][/ja]
examples:
<ons-page>
  <ons-if orientation="landscape">
    Landscape view!
  </ons-if>
  <ons-if platform="android">
    This is Android.
  </ons-if>
  <ons-if platform="ios other">
    This is not Android.
  </ons-if>
</ons-page>

guides.name: theming.html#cross-platform-styling-autostyling
guides.description: [en]Information about cross platform styling[/en][ja]Information about cross platform styling[/ja]

attributes.name: platform
attributes.description:
[en]Space-separated platform names. Possible values are `"ios"`, `"android"`, `"windows"` and `"other"`.[/en]
[ja][/ja]

attributes.name: orientation
attributes.description:
[en]Either `"portrait"` or `"landscape"`.[/en]
[ja]portraitもしくはlandscapeを指定します[/ja]
